title: Watching and listening: néz and hallgat

sections.title: Two verbs with an object
sections.content: *Néz* means to watch and *hallgat* means to listen to. Here both have an object. For a film or music in general use the indefinite ending: *Filmet nézek. Zenét hallgatok.* The *-ek* goes with the front vowel of *néz*, the *-ok* with the back vowels of *hallgat*. For one particular film or piece of music the verb is definite: *A filmet nézem. A zenét hallgatom.*

items.english: I am listening to the music.

sections.content: *Hallgat* needs something to listen to: *zenét hallgatok*. And answer *Mit nézel?* with the object alone: *Filmet*, not *Filmet nézel.*
